Seeing conflicting claims about Larkhaven Library this Saturday. The public schedule shared here lists 10:00–18:00, with the reading room and book returns available; another post says closed all day. Check the library’s latest notice or contact them before making a trip—I wouldn’t treat the closure claim as confirmed.
